units.source_text: 明石皇后到了六条院之后，众侍女都觉得这里比宫中宽敞，更多趣味，住得更舒服。

en.t: After Empress Akashi arrived at the Rokujo estate, all the ladies-in-waiting felt that it was more spacious than the palace, more interesting, and more comfortable to live in.

units.source_text: 平日不常来伺候的侍女，也都跟来，无拘无束地住着。

en.t: Even the attendants who did not usually come to serve her followed along and lived there freely, without constraint.

units.source_text: 长长的一排边屋，以及回廊、廊房等处，住得满坑满谷。

en.t: The long row of side rooms, the covered corridors, the corridor chambers, and every such place were packed full with residents.

units.source_text: 夕雾左大臣的威势不亚于源氏当时，凡事都经营得尽善尽美，用以招待皇后。

en.t: The Left Minister Yugiri possessed authority no less impressive than Genji's in his day, and he arranged everything to perfection in order to receive the Empress.

units.source_text: 源氏这一族日渐繁荣，比较起从前来，一切排场反而更加新颖了。

en.t: Genji's family was growing more prosperous by the day, and compared with the past, all its ceremonial display had become even more fresh and splendid.

units.source_text: 匂亲王如果依旧好色，则皇后居住六条院的期间，不知会做出多少色情之事来呢。

en.t: If Prince Niou had still been as amorous as before, who knows how many scandalous affairs he might have pursued while the Empress was staying at Rokujo.

units.source_text: 幸而这时候他非常安静。

en.t: Fortunately, at this time he was very quiet.

units.source_text: 别人看见了，都以为他生来具有的恶癖已经稍稍改去了。

en.t: Seeing this, everyone thought that the bad habit he had been born with had already improved a little.

units.source_text: 岂知近日老毛病又发作起来，看中了那个宫君，一直在打主意。

en.t: But in fact, recently his old weakness had flared up again; he had set his sights on that princess and was constantly scheming about her.
